§33.7 Integral Representations

ⓘ
Keywords:
Coulomb functions: variables ρ,η, integral representations
Notes:
See Hull and Breit (1959, pp. 413–416). For (33.7.1) see also Lowan and Horenstein (1942), with change of variable ξ=1−t in the integral that follows Eq. (8). For (33.7.2) see also Hoisington and Breit (1938). For (33.7.3) see also Bloch et al. (1950). For (33.7.4) see also Newton (1952).
